scope: Focused primary-literature reconnaissance for a repository seed. This is not a systematic review or proof of novelty.
novelty_status: A direct older-ephemeris versus later-observation coverage benchmark already exists in ExoClock IV Section V.1/Table 5. Reproduce it before claiming an extension.
date_policy: arXiv submission dates are recorded as submission dates, not automatically public availability timestamps. Strict operational forecast issue dates require announcement, repository, website snapshot, or other release evidence.
author_policy: Author arrays marked authors_truncated=true are deliberately abbreviated verified lists. Use an et-al/others representation rather than implying these are complete author lists; replace using verified citation exports before manuscript submission.
